PROP-1ada093f-inv-005.text: Snapshot count must increase by exactly 1 on begin_transaction and decrease by 1 on commit/rollback.
PROP-1ada093f-inv-005.assertion: begin_tx(s): len(s._snapshots)_post == len(s._snapshots)_pre + 1; commit/rollback: len_post == len_pre - 1
